name: HR Cloud
summary: HR Cloud sells an Onboard plan alongside Growth and Full Suite, aimed at mid-market and hourly workforces. Onboarding tasks route to HR, managers, IT and the new hire, forms are signed online, and new hires get a mobile welcome page. Prices are quote only, on an annual license tied to headcount.

facts.text: The onboarding page says tasks are assigned by role and HR can see which items are due, overdue or complete.
The onboarding page says HR can send forms, collect signatures, track completion and send reminders to people who have not finished.
The onboarding page describes a mobile-first, branded welcome for new hires with their documents and next steps before the start date.

The onboarding page states that HR Cloud maintains SOC 2 Type II certification and follows GDPR data-handling practices. It describes HIPAA-sensitive document handling for healthcare but does not claim HIPAA certification.
The pricing page has a separate small-business section for companies under 250 employees, and the FAQ asks prospects to share team size to confirm a package.
